name: Szigetmonostor (Hungary)
description: White field with a narrow yellow vertical stripe at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Szigetmonostor (a white shield with three red roses and a wavy stripe, within a wreath of grain) below the name SZIGETMONOSTOR in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
